_comment: What a user sees when a request fails (S2-90, design documents/architecture/safe-errors-and-alerts-design-2026-11-18.md §2). utils/user_errors.js tries the rules in order; the first match decides the class; no match = 'internal'. A rule matches when EVERY field it lists matches: names = error class name (OpenAI SDK: RateLimitError, AuthenticationError, ...), codes = err.code / err.type / err.error.code / err.error.type, statuses = err.status, message_includes = case-insensitive substrings of err.message. Messages are fixed text: never err.message. The full cause stays in the logs (user_error event). Alerts on these codes: scripts/alerts.json.

ai_unavailable.message: Cortex-Drive can't answer questions right now. The owner has been notified.

ai_busy.message: Cortex-Drive is busy. Try again in a minute.

graph_unavailable.message: The knowledge graph is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

timeout.message: That took too long. Try a narrower question.

internal.message: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell the owner.
